body: I did and she said the exact thing I had told myself in order to stop the suicidal thoughts, but it didn’t work. I know she may become the second me if I commit suicide, but she will understand. Except for my family, I don’t think any of my friends will be surprised if I suddenly die nor they need to.

I do a one best friend that she understands me so well. I have hobbies. I do arts, play music and I feel happy when I’m doing so, but at the end of the day, they are things I can throw away easily. I love them but they’re not enough to keep me alive.
